score_scale.policy: candidate declares raw|prob and its transform before scoring; the transform is recorded, never silent

ranking_rule: expected record ranked first among candidates; threshold-free
abstention_rule: threshold = midpoint between the highest irrelevant score and the lowest relevant score on these held-out pairs; if the bands overlap, abstention is reported UNCALIBRATABLE rather than fitted anyway
abstention_note: calibration uses eval/s3/calibration_set.py only; the nine cases never inform the threshold
veto_policy: R4 and R5 are judged on the selection verdict; a ranking failure is reported separately and is never offset by calibration

conditions.detail: natural-language rendering is a separate experiment and must not replace C-SCHEMA
